bluetooth_confirm.title: Eufy Local Light
bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name}? Home Assistant will connect to the light to read its serial number. Close the Eufy app first: the light accepts only one Bluetooth connection at a time.

user.title: Eufy Local Light
user.description: Enter the light's Bluetooth address. The serial number is read from the light and the user ID can be left blank; fill them in only if setup fails without them. See the README for how to find them.

user_id.title: Eufy account user ID
user_id.description: The light didn't accept setup without an account. Enter your Eufy user ID (see the README).

error.invalid_serial: The serial number must be exactly 16 characters.
error.invalid_user_id: The user ID must be at least 16 characters.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't connect to the light. Make sure it is powered and in range, and close the Eufy app, which can hold the light's only Bluetooth connection.
error.handshake_failed: The light refused the connection. Check the user ID.

init.title: Color tuning
init.description: Fine-tune how Home Assistant colors map to the strip. When setting up my lights i felt that the colors were always leaning twoards the lighters side. But im also colorblind so your milage may vary
